column1: # Adapter time limits, one row per limit or knob: name, value, unit, kind, owner and meaning.
# Single owner of these numbers (bin/fm-adapter-limits.sh owns reading and checking them).
# kind "limit" is a ceiling a supervisor adapter imposes; kind "knob" is a default the arm picks.
# Tab-separated. Add a row here before adding a wait, then run bin/fm-adapter-limits.sh check.

column5: .claude/settings.json: the Claude hook that runs the arm is killed after this long
Pi, omp, OpenCode adapters: base time an arm may take to report started before the adapter terminates it (the adapter adds bin/fm-arm-budget.sh seconds on a loaded host)
Pi, omp, OpenCode adapters: how long a terminated unready arm may take to exit (FM_WATCH_ARM_RETIRE_TIMEOUT_MS)
bin/fm-wake-lib.sh: ceiling of the load-stretched confirmation window (FM_ARM_CONFIRM_CAP)
bin/fm-wake-lib.sh: ceiling of the wait before re-arming after a failed start (FM_ARM_BACKOFF_CAP)
bin/fm-watch-arm.sh: wait for a starting watcher to reach cleanup before the TERM is forwarded (FM_ARM_TERM_WAIT_MS)
